from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u092/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=base/'task-20f93ffb.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 1]
    points.sort()
    if len(points) < 2:
        return out
    dr = points[1][0] - points[0][0]
    dc = points[1][1] - points[0][1]
    if dr <= 0 or dc <= 0 or dr != dc:
        return out
    if any((b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]) != (dr, dc) for a, b in zip(points, points[1:])):
        return out
    r, c = points[-1]
    while r + dr < len(out) and c + dc < len(out[0]):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
path.write_text(code)
# Build demo pair and test using the requested transform.
ns={}
exec(code,ns)
demo=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r,c in [(1,1),(3,3),(5,5)]: demo[r][c]=1
actual=ns['transform'](demo)
expected=[row[:] for row in demo]
for r,c in [(7,7),(9,9),(11,11),(13,13)]: expected[r][c]=2
print('demo reproduces:', actual==expected)
test=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r,c in [(0,0),(3,3),(6,6)]: test[r][c]=1
result=ns['transform'](test)
print(result)
